name: cpapfit-website
description: cpapfit.ca site source. `npm run build` writes the upload-ready site to ../../cpapfit.ca

scripts.zip: node build.mjs && cd ../../cpapfit.ca && if [ -f NOT-READY-TO-UPLOAD.txt ]; then cat NOT-READY-TO-UPLOAD.txt; exit 1; fi && zip -qr "../cpapfit website planning/cpapfit-upload-$(date +%F).zip" . -x .DS_Store && echo "Created cpapfit website planning/cpapfit-upload-$(date +%F).zip"
